summary.en: The Philippine Coast Guard contained an oil spill in Mariveles, Bataan and removed 800 kg of contaminated debris, while the navy is probing a reservist's social media post that incited violence in Manila. China warned it could cut undersea cables linking Taiwan and the Philippines and increased patrols near Taiwan, raising maritime tension, and a Chinese survey vessel entered Scarborough Shoal with unidentified equipment. The Coast Guard deployed its flagship BRP Teresa Magbanua to southeastern Mindanao to intensify maritime patrols and deter illegal activities, and a nationwide earthquake drill tested tsunami preparedness in Cagayan. The conflict remains low-intensity, with 176 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
